name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>: domain = battle in-combat spell-selection UI, descriptor = menu_main (the main modal entry, the only caller fd2_player_inline_action_menu_dispatch invokes it when the player picks 'Spell'). Name accurately reflects purpose (drive the whole spell pick + target + cast flow). No Ghidra address residue.
purpose: Battle in-combat spell-selection modal main entry: slide in the spell-picker over the status screen, run the selection input loop, then resolve targets and perform the chosen spell (ordinary cast or per-spell status handler), returning whether a cast happened / target was cancelled / the menu was cancelled.
logic_summary: Allocates 3x64000 work buffers (accumulator/snapshot/composed), snapshots the VGA frame at 0xA0000, renders the static status layout + spell list (highlight -1) into the composed buffer, plays a 12-frame slide-in. Resets the shared menu cursor to 0 and repeats fd2_spell_select_input_loop(caster_idx) until non-zero. Plays a 12-frame slide-out, restores the VGA snapshot, frees the buffers. On Esc (loop_result == -1) returns -1. Otherwise rebuilds the usable-spell id list, looks up the spell effect record, sets battle_anim_phase = pSpell[4]+2, reads aoe_kind = pSpell[3]. Three target-selection branches: (a) aoe_kind != 0 && spell_id == 0x17 (teleport-class): source-range pick then a free destination pick via wait mode 6, recording the teleport destination world coords and panning the cursor on commit; (b) aoe_kind == 0 || spell_id == 0x17 (single target): compute targets in range, wait mode 5 when none in range else 4; (c) else (AoE): compute the AoE anchor (wait mode pSpell[6]), with spell 0x1E using a line scan and all others a second AoE compute pass to resolve the final hit list. On cancel (result_or_aoe == -1) restore the cursor and return 0. On hit: composite the frame, then for spell_id < 9 || == 0x18 || > 0x1B call fd2_play_spell_cast_sequence, else (status/special spells 9..0x1B except 0x18) load status SFX, play the palette flash, invoke data_fd2_battle_spell_handler_table[spell_id](caster_idx, n_targets, target_buf), free the SFX; then collect/animate/process death drops, set battle_anim_phase = 1, return 1.

params.name: caster_idx
params.semantics: Runtime character array index of the acting character (the spell caster). Caller fd2_player_inline_action_menu_dispatch passes its own char_idx. Forwarded to fd2_render_status_screen_static_layout, fd2_draw_spell_selection_list, fd2_spell_select_input_loop, fd2_build_usable_spell_list, fd2_pan_cursor_to_char, fd2_play_spell_cast_sequence, and the per-spell status handler.
params.reason: Accurately names the caster/acting character index used throughout; no address residue, not a generic param_N placeholder.

returns.semantics: 1 = a cast was performed; 0 = target selection cancelled (Esc during targeting); -1 = the spell menu itself was cancelled (Esc in the list). Caller loops while 0 (re-prompt) and treats -1 as 'back to outer menu'.
